{{Quote|That's the way the flatcake crumbles.|A common saying during the Cold War|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''flatcake''', or '''flat cake''', was a flat, circular [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that was common in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and came in a number of varieties, such as the popular [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshani]] flatcake. Edible to a variety of [[Species/Legends|species]], flatcakes were the subject of some popular sayings or insults and were a common food throughout various periods of [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]], such as the [[Mandalorian Wars]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Would you like a sweet flatcake instead? It's fresh.|Loonda|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Flatcakes, also known as flat cakes, were a flat and circular [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that varied in size;<ref name="Days" /> some varieties were the sweet flatcake,<ref name="Deadly">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Deadly Delivery|Ord Mantell}}</ref> the toasted flatcake, and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshani]] flatcake, which could be served with sautéed [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="Days" /> [[Shredded grum]] on flatcake was also a type of food that was common during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref> Flatcakes were edible to a variety of [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], Trandoshans, and [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvians]].<ref name="Days" />

==History==
{{Quote|Today's match is sponsored by Brassk's Trandoshani Flatcakes&mdash;the only flatcakes served with authentic fruit from the elder trees of Kashyyyk.|[[Baron Deathmark]], announcing a [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] match sponsored by Brassk's Trandoshani Flatcakes|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Flatcake.png|thumb|left|160px|R2-D2 prepares flatcakes.]]
Flatcakes were prevalent in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]], the Trandoshan [[Slyssk]] discovered that [[Gender/Legends|he]] could greatly improve the flavor of Trandoshani flatcakes by sautéing them with fruit.<ref name="Days" /> Over three hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Brassk's Trandoshani Flatcakes]] was a company that produced Trandoshani flatcakes and claimed to be the only company that served them with authentic fruit from the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Warzone">{{TORcite|type=warzone|Huttball}}</ref> [[Loonda]], a Human woman who lived on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the Cold War, regularly made sweet flatcakes.<ref name="Deadly" />

"Flatcake" was sometimes used as an insult,<ref name="Barter">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|A Barter with the Lady of Pain|Tatooine}}</ref> and "a piece of flatcake" was a common expression that was used to express how easy something was.<ref name="Colicoid">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Colicoid War Game}}</ref> The [[COO-series cook droid/Legends|COO cook droid]] [[COO-2180/Legends|COO-2180]]<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> served flatcakes aboard the [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|passenger liner]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Jendirian Valley/Legends|''Jendirian Valley'']] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEGTD" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War, shredded grum on flatcake was a common food eaten by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="Allegiance" /> Flatcakes were still popular by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[137 ABY]], when the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] made a stack of flatcakes for the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Rawk family]] and [[Jariah Syn]] on the planet [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]].<ref name="Legacy">[[Legacy (2006) 34|''Legacy'' (2006) 34]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I get it. You want me to meet with these Colicoids&mdash;work out a deal. Piece of flatcake, your Masterfulness. Leave it to me.|A [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] character, to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Flatcakes first briefly appeared in the theatrical film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="AOTC" /> They were first mentioned by name in the novel [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']], which was released in [[January]] [[2007]],<ref name="Allegiance" /> and a variety of flatcakes, the Trandoshani flatcake, then appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]] in [[April]] 2007.<ref name="Days" /> The food has received mentions in a number of different sources since then. Flatcake is used as an [[in-universe]] equivalent to a number of real-life pastries, including cake,<ref name="Colicoid" /> cookies,<ref name="Escaping Korriban">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Kira Carsen|Escaping Korriban}}</ref> and pancakes.<ref name="Days" />
